Zero extra calls"},{"id":"p1s3","text":", zero latency, 12 languages."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-think-any-lang"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **Thinking Language** dropdown under **Settings → General**, l"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"etting you choose which language the model uses for its reasoning / chain of thought (中文, English, 日"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"本語, 한국어, Deutsch, …). **The final reply stays in the user's language.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Screenshots · Features · How it works · Installation · Usage · Development · Publishing · Star Histo"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"reenshots · Features · How it works · Installation · Usage · Development · Publishing · Star History"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Selector in General settings
Pick it right from the settings page"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The selector box
Click to expand and pick a language"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"All languages in one dropdown
off plus 12 languages in one list"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"In the plugin list
Listed under plugin management after install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Settings → General → Thinking Language**: a dropdown to pick the language the model thinks in.
-"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" **Zero latency, zero extra calls**: implemented as a system-prompt instruction (`systemPrompt.secti"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"on`) — no extra model calls or response delay like "translate the reasoning" approaches.
- **Instruc"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"tions written in the target language**: each instruction is written in its own language (e.g. the En"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"glish instruction is written in English), which improves model adherence.
- **Persisted**: the choic"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"e is stored in the user settings document (settings service) and survives restarts.
- **Plain JS, no"},{"id":"p11s7","text":" build step**: both the host and browser halves are hand-written JavaScript; install straight from G"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"itHub with zero friction."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Supported languages: `off` (follow default, no instruction), Simplified Chinese, English, 日本語, 한국어, "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, Русский, Italiano, العربية, हिन्दी."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Half | Responsibility |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| `index.js` (host half) | Registers the `think-any-lang` settings namespace (`language` field, enum"},{"id":"p15s2","text":", default `zh`); watches for changes and mounts `systemPrompt.section` (named `think-any-lang`) when"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" non-`off`, unmounts on `off`; also registers a private loopback RPC channel `/think-any-lang` (`get"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"`/`set`) that the browser half uses to read/write the namespace |
| `client.js` (browser half) | Reg"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"isters a `settings.general.item` row via the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` contract; renders the dr"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"opdown and reads/writes the setting through the host half's `/think-any-lang` RPC channel |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> **Why a private RPC channel instead of the settings RPC surface?** `dsh-host-apiproxy` only expose"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"s an explicit allowlist of settings namespaces to configuration clients (`WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` /"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" `PRODUCT_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES`); a third-party namespace answers `settings-not-exposed`, so the sele"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ction would never persist. The browser half therefore talks to a private channel registered in-proce"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ss (`ctx.connection.rpc.handle`), and in-process `ctx.settings` access is not filtered by that allow"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"list — persistence and the `systemPrompt` linkage stay unchanged."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> The language table is maintained in two places — `index.js` (instruction texts) and `client.js` (d"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"isplay labels): the browser factory's `require` only resolves platform modules and cannot read local"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" modules, so each half keeps its own language view. Keep both files in sync when adding a language."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Requirements: `dsh` CLI installed with an initialized profile (`dsh plugin --profile <name> add` aut"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"dsh` CLI installed with an initialized profile (`dsh plugin --profile <name> add` auto-initializes)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### From GitHub (recommended)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> The package is pure JS with no `prepare` build script, so no pnpm ≥10 `allowBuilds` approval is ne"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"eded — install straight from GitHub. Pinning to a commit is recommended as in the official docs: `gi"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"thub:lco117/dsh-think-any-lang#<commit-sha>`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### From a local directory (development)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Verify"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"1. Start `dsh web`.
2. Open **Settings → General**.
3. Pick a language in the **Thinking Language** "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"dropdown (default: Chinese).
4. Subsequent model calls receive the thinking-language instruction in "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"the system prompt; DeepSeek reasoning models typically output `reasoning_content` in the chosen lang"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ystem prompt; DeepSeek reasoning models typically output `reasoning_content` in the chosen language."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Tech Stack"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Category | Tech |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Plugin platform | DeepSeek Harness (DSH) |
